source: FIX 2026-10-04: row 'Profit before income tax' renamed 'Profit Before Taxation' so tax is read from 'Income Tax'. | FY2026 (year ended 30 June 2026, condensed audited) added from East African Breweries Plc condensed audited results for the year ended 30 June 2026 (NSE filing, via africanfinancials.com); Kshs'M x1e6. Row 'Profit before income tax' renamed 'Profit Before Taxation' so bot/statements.py reads tax from the Income Tax row, not from a profit-before-tax row. | kenyanstocks.com financial statements API (farmed, complete) | kenyanstocks.com financial statements API, farmed harvest. Profit Before Tax derived as Net Profit plus Income Tax; Gross Profit as Revenue minus Cost of Sales. Cross checked: Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax equals Net Profit and Revenue minus Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit. | CRON 20260929_003746: Income Tax sign normalised to the dataset convention, the charge stored positive and a credit negative, on 3 period(s), so that the rendered Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit. The required sign is fixed by the direction of the move from Profit Before Tax to Net Profit in the stored rows, and the stored magnitude already agreed with that move.
source_note: EABL condensed audited results for the year ended 30 June 2025 (Kshs million: operating costs 29,220; EBIT 25,171; PBT 19,312; profit for the year 12,198; basic EPS 11.97. FY2024: 24,830 / 24,897 / 16,771 / 10,870 / 10.30) | https://eabl.com/~/media/Files/E/eabl/documents/investor/financial-result/2025/eabl-f25-full-year-2025-financial-results-press-release.pdf FY2026 column from the company filing (https://africanfinancials.com/document/ke-eabl-2026-ab-00/): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them. UNIT CHECK: values whose magnitude did not reconcile with the annual column were withheld (filing unit differed from the statement unit); they were not rescaled. | CRON 20261004_1032: EPS for FY2022 filled with the issuer's printed comparative, Basic and diluted 15.00, from EABL audited results for the year ended 30 June 2023 (eabl.com results booklet); ties to profit attributable to equity holders 11,857,336k over 790,774,356 shares.
